narrative.northStar: a secret inside an old computer
narrative.overview: the supplied windows-classic direction governs the interface: teal desktop, silver bevels, navy active title bars, original pixel icons, and compact applications. evidence is shown in the application that reveals it. the desktop is usable scenery, while the active puzzle receives the strongest hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: square windows and tactile raised or sunken controls.
short lowercase copy with legible evidence and timestamps.
an immediate mystery, with no boot sequence.
responsive application panels and optional audio.
dos: do preserve the pinned classic desktop palette and square bevel language.
do make the puzzle artifact larger and clearer than its controls.
do pair every diagram state with a text label and provide keyboard controls.
do keep every visible control functional.
donts: don't introduce glass, rounded dashboard cards, or decorative hacker terminals.
don't require precision dragging, audio, or external research to solve a chapter.
don't claim the two-to-four-minute target is measured without human playtesting.
